description.text: Vulkan is available in flat and Quest VR modes on Minecraft 26.2 and later. Fixes 26.2 startup and 26.3 flat presentation. Matching Vivecraft builds support entering VR after loading and switching back in game. Adds Quest 3/3S Turnip and improves MobileGlues compatibility.
Minecraft 26.2 及以上支持平面与 Quest VR Vulkan。修复 26.2 启动和 26.3 平面显示，配套 Vivecraft 支持加载后进入 VR 和游戏内往返切换。新增 Quest 3 / 3S Turnip 驱动，改善 MobileGlues 渲染兼容性。
